stockSourceReview.scope: All tracked .c, .h, .inc and .S files under firmware/src and firmware/hal, including inactive source. Checked full identifier occurrences, not only direct-call syntax. Reviewed the reset assembly and linker script for named entries separately. This is a source disposition, not an additional executed function or physical measurement.
stockSourceReview.tokenPasting: The only ## in the scanned C tokens constructs X0X_EXP_##tab in drum909.c. It cannot form a listed helper name.
stockSourceReview.lane: Only ui.c:6060 spells lane followed by an opening parenthesis. The other identifier occurrences refer to structure members, offsets, parameter declarations or local variables, including the address of the local step_lane_snapshot_t in knobs_sig.

excludedByPageDispatch.strip_value_fit: Its only call requires a drum reference in draw_param_widget. That widget is called only from draw_part_sound on bass pages. Both the main-band and knob-strip drum selection dispatch to draw_drum_voice.
excludedByPageDispatch.dg_tail: Its callers require DG_DECAY or DG_NTAIL in drum_strip_glyph. Outside the bass matrix widget, the only call to drum_strip_glyph requires DG_LEVEL. drum_strip_role rejects a bass reference.
excludedByPageDispatch.original_cell_value: describe_pages only emits R_ENG/T_303 and the three R_BENGINE/R_BPRESET/R_BSTATUS controls under V_PART for bass. draw_knobs returns at ui.c:8495 for that part and view. V_SEQ uses R_BPATSND, which does not satisfy the call predicate.
